new group banavnyasathi part 1: step 1 :  new group tayar karnyasathi sarvat adhi whatsapp madhe jaa.
step 2 : whatsapp chya sarvat varti ujavya baajula rupaya che chinha disel.
step 3 : tya chinha cha bajula photo cameryache chinha disel aani tyachya bajula teen timba disel.
step 4 : teen timba var touch kar.
step 5 : touch kelya nantar ek list yeil sarvat var new group lihun disel.
step 6 : tyaa new group var touch kar.
step 7 : touch kelya nantar ek navin page open hoil sarvaat varchya daavya bajula <- asa baan disel to maage parat janyasathi aahe.
new group banavnyasathi part 2: step 8 : tyachya bajula ek search box ahe - tyavar Name number @username lihlela asel tyavar touch karun tumhi jya vyaktila kiwa number la shodhu shakta.
step 9 : example 'jayesh' ase lihlyavar jayesh naavashi sambandhit naave search box chya khali disel.
step 10 : tya naavanchya bajula ek gol tikli disel tya tiklivar touch kelya nantar ti tikli hirwya rangane bharli jail ani barobar cha chinha yeil.
step 11 : yaacha arth te naav kiwa number nivadle ahe.
step 12 : ashaach prakare pudhil naave pan nivadu shakta tumhala naave nivdnyasathi paddhat punha punha vaparaychi ahe.
step 13 : konti paddhat : search box madhe naav liha tyachya bajula dislelya tiklivar touch kara.
step 14 : naave nivdun jhalya nantar search box chya khali nivadleli naave disel tyachyasobat ek chukiche chinha disel tyavar touch karun tumhi te naav kami karu shakta.
new group banavnyasathi part 3: step 15 : naave nivdun jhalya nantar sarvat khali ujavya baajula ek hirwya rangacha button disel tyavar -> asa baan asel.
step 16 : tya baan var touch kelyavar ek navin page open hoil.
step 17 : tya page var sarvat varti New group ase lihlela disel tyachya khali camera che chitra disel.
step 18 : tyavar touch kelyavar tumhi camera ne photo kadhun kinwa gallery madhun photo nivdu shakta aaplya groupchya profile sathi.
step 19 : ha photo group la odakh deto photo varun lokanna kalta ki ha group kashyasathi ahe.
step 20 : camera chinha chya javal ek khali box aayat disel tyavar Group name ase lihelela asel tyavar touch karun tumhi group la naav deu shakta.
step 21 : naav lihun zalyavar khali ek hirwya rangache button disel tyavar barobar che chinha asel te touch kelyavar group tayar hoil.
payments feature account add karne part: step 1 : whatsapp madhe jaa tyachya sarvat varti ujavya baajula rupaya che chinha disel.
step 2 : tya chinha var touch kara. ek navin page open hoil.
step 3 : tya page chya madhya bhaga var 'add bank account' ase lihile asel tyavar touch kar.
step 4 : ek navin page open hoil tyavar 'popular banks' chya khali vividh bankanche naav disel. ex. State bank of india, Axis Bank, etc.
step 5 : jar tumchi bank yaa madhye nasel tar tumhi sarvat var ujavya bajula ek prashna chinha asel tyachya bajula ek 'q' ase bhinga che chinha asel tyavar touch kara
step 6 : touch kelyavar 'enter bank name' ase lihilele disel tyavar tumchi bank sodhu shakta
step 7 : tumhi bankache naav lihun zalyavar tumhala tumchi bank khali lihun disel tya var touch kara
step 8 : tumhi bankache naav touch kelyavar khali 'allow whatsapp to send and view messages' yavar Allow button touch kara.
step 9 : Allow buttonavar touch kelyavar ek page open hoil ya page var whatsapp tumcha bank khatey sodhat asel.ex 'finding you bank account' ase lihun disel thoda vel thambaave lagel.

step 10 : shodh purn jhalyavar tumche bank account add hoil. ek page open hoil tyavar sarvat var 'payments' ase lihle asel tya page chya sarvat khaali 'Manage payments' section ahe tya khali tumhala tumche purn naav disel
step 11 : naava chya khali tumcha UPI id disel yacha arth tumche account yashasvi ritya add jhale aahe
payments feature UPI PIN set va paise pa: step 12 : scan UPI or QR code he 'payments' page var eka chaukonat disel tyavar touch kara.
step 13 : camera open hoil tumhi jar QR code samor asel tar camera tyavar focus kar.
step 14 : QR code focus kelyavar camera tyacha scan karel ani ek navin page open hoil.
step 15 : ya page var tumhi jya vyaktila paise pathavnar ahat tyache naav var lihun disel.
step 16 : page chya madhya bhaga var rupaya che chinha asel tyavar touch kara.
step 17 : touch kelyavar ek 1 te 9 ani 0 ase numbers disel tyavar touch karun tumhala kiti paise tya vyaktila pathavache ahe te liha.
step 18: example 1 rupaye lihun zalyavar khali 'send' ase hirwya rangache button asel tyavar touch kara.
step 19 : touch kelyavar khali 'set UPI PIN' ase disel tyach khali hirwya rangacha button 'continue' asel tyavar touch kara.
step 20 : touch kelya var ek page open hoil tyavar tumhala tumchya ATM card mhanjech 'debit card' chi shevatchi 6 anka takaychi ahe ani 'EXpiry date' takaychi ahe example 01/34
step 21 : ATM card chi shevatchi 6 anka ani expiry date lihun zalyavar khali hirwya rangacha button 'confirm' asel tyavar touch kara.
step 22 : touch kelyavar ek navin page open hoil ya page var tumhala UPI PIN set karaycha ahe example SBI bank sathi 6 anki PIN set karaycha ahe tya ankan var touch karun tumhi PIN set karu shakta
step 23 : PIN type kelyavar khali '✓' ase barobar che chinha disel tyavar touch kara.
step 24 : touch kelyavar UPI PIN confirm karayla sangel parat to PIN type karayla sangel.
step 25 : parat PIN type kelyavar khali '✓' ase barobar che chinha disel tyavar touch kara.
step 26 : touch kelyavar UPI PIN set hoil yacha arth tumhi paise pathavnyasathi tayar ahat
step 27 : PIN set zalyavar tumhi parat send payment page var yaal jithe tya vyaktiche naav disel jyala tumhi paise pathavnar ahat
step 28 : ya page var rupayachya chinhavar touch karun tumhi kiti paise pathvache ahe te liha ani 'send' button var touch kara
step 29 : tumhi 'send' button var touch kelyavar ek page open hoil tithe tumhala tumcha UPI PIN takaycha ahe.
step 30 : UPI PIN type kelyavar khali '✓' ase barobar che chinha disel tyavar touch kara.
step 31 : touch kelyavar tumhala kahi seconds vaat pahayla lagel tyanantar hirwya rangachya vartul madhe '✓' chinha disel yacha arth tumche paise pathavle gele aahet.
step 32 : aani khali suddha lihun disel example 'paid to jayesh' kiwa tya vyaktiche naav

step 36 : tumhala aata jya vyaktila paise pathvache ahet tya vyakticha mobile number kiwa naav liha.

step 39 : sarvat khali 1 te 9 ani 0 ase anka disat astil te tya ankanvar touch karun tumhi rakkam kiwa amount taku shakta.
step 40 : amount takun zalyavar khali 'send' ase hirwya rangache button asel tyavar touch kara.
step 41 : touch kelyavar ek navin page open hoil tithe tumhala tumcha UPI PIN takaycha ahe.
step 42 : UPI PIN type kelyavar khali '✓' ase barobar che chinha disel tyavar touch kara.
step 43 : touch kelyavar tumhala kahi seconds vaat pahayla lagel tyanantar hirwya rangachya vartul madhe '✓' chinha disel yacha arth tumche paise pathavle gele aahet.
step 44 : aani khali suddha lihun disel example 'paid to jayesh' kiwa tya vyaktiche naav disel kiwa 'tya vaktichya chat madhe suddha example 'sent to jayesh kiwa tya vyaktiche naav disel
payments feature account balance check k: step 45 : payments page var jaa 'scan UPI or QR code' ani 'pay mobile number' chya bajula 'view account balance' ase disel tyavar touch kara.
step 46 : touch kelyavar ek navin page open hoil tithe tumhala tumcha 'UPI PIN' takaycha ahe.
step 47 : 'UPI PIN' taklyavar sarvat khali '✓' ase barobar che chinha disel tyavar touch kara.
step 48 : touch kelyavar tumhala tumcha account balance disel.
